deviations: Kbd: label is left-aligned (primaryAxisAlign MIN) inside the kept min width = H, so a Kbd group reads 'Ctrl+K' and not 'Ctrl+ K'.

Badge / Badge / kind: the dot is unpainted and taken out of the flow (layoutPositioning ABSOLUTE), so dot=true shows nothing and adds no gap. Height 20 and padding 0/6 are literal (the space/badge/* tokens resolve to Density values 22/8). The iconStartGlyph default is now Fluent/Icon/circle-check (property name unchanged).
Avatar: agent is the Fluent Color bot_24_color (152:775) rescaled to 16/20/24 for sm/md/lg (the brief gives only md 20). Presence nests Fluent/Avatar presence.
Avatar presence offline: no fill, with a theme-only child 'ring' (1px INSIDE fluent/stroke/control-strong); the root keeps the 2px OUTSIDE fluent/solid/base ring.

Avatar group: all four members are initials avatars (royal-blue MR, teal AT, grape JW, marigold LK), not the base images, to show one palette per member. At sm (24) the -8 overlap clips the second initial ('M', 'A' read cut). The variants are stacked in one column.
.Item icon tile: the glyph default is Fluent/Icon/file-text, bound to size/icon/lg (20).

Item: sm and xs keep the stated padding (12; 8/12), so two-line rows grow to 60 and 52. The 48 and 40 heights are minimums that a single-line row meets. Gap after media: 20 (default size), 12 (sm, xs). The mediaContent default is now Fluent/.Item icon tile. muted hover = fluent/control/secondary (derived). Strokes are excluded from layout.

Item group: separators=false rows are Fluent/Item outline sm (the SettingsCard stack, 4 apart). separators=true rows are Fluent/Item default sm on one card. Media overrides are remapped to the Fluent/Avatar md initials (465:105163) and agent (465:105171) variants.

Card: sm uses padding 12 (md 16). rule cards have no side padding. The rule selected state is fluent/subtle/secondary with a fluent/stroke/control-strong top rule. The base bound card shadow effect is kept (it resolves to 0 under Fluent). The body .Slot stroke is overridden to fluent/stroke/divider.

Stat card: the root is now horizontal: 'icon' (moved out of 'header', 32px, default iconGlyph data_trending_32_color 152:769) sits left of a theme-only 'stack' frame holding header, value, detail and the deco parts (part names unchanged, path changed). The icon boolean keeps its base default false, so the icon shows only when the instance turns it on. Default height 110 (hero 126) with stack gap 2. The delta arrows are the FSI 12 filled colour components (152:766 / 152:767) recoloured to the success or critical role.
Table header cell: for sort=none the sort-icon (Fluent/Icon/arrow-up-down) stays bound to 'sortable' but is unpainted and taken out of the flow, so it shows nothing.
Table cell: avatar = Fluent/Avatar md initials (not the base image); actions = Fluent/Icon button / md ghost with glyph more-horizontal and label 'Row actions' re-applied after resetOverrides.

Table row: table/inset stays 0. The 12 content inset comes from the cell padding (the brief's 'padding-left 12'). disabled drops the base 0.38 layer opacity and paints every text fluent/text/disabled (badges and avatars keep their colours). The selected select cell has its checkbox set to checked=true.

Table: root padding 4 inside the card, so the r4 rows sit inside the r8 card. The head is 36 with no fill and no rule. empty/loading: the base B7 'empty' and B6 'skeleton-row' parts are kept hidden; theme-only 'empty-text' and 'loading-row' (Fluent/Spinner md 'size=md, tone=primary' + 'Loading orders…') stand in.
gotchas: Bound paints whose variable resolves to alpha 0 (table/row-bg, table/head) keep the stored seed colour and render it. Seed every bound paint with its resolved colour (variable.resolveForConsumer(node)). A re-seed pass fixed 21 paints in 465:98978; run it again after any new build.

The children of hidden nested instances (bound to a false boolean) are not reachable. To tint such glyphs, flip the boolean default to true with editComponentProperty, tint, then flip it back (used for Badge icon/remove and Item chevron).
editComponentProperty({defaultValue}) on an INSTANCE_SWAP property swaps every bound instance in all variants.
resetOverrides() was used on purpose on focus-ring, Item media, Table cell avatar and actions. Each part name was re-applied right after (the G3 bug note).
